traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: This report covers a qualitative (detection) method for Listeria spp. (NEOGEN Molecular Detection Assay 2 - Listeria), certificate # 3M 01/14 – 05/16, renewed in April 2024 without additional testing. The per-category method comparison values recorded here are from Table 6/Table 7 (sensitivity study, individual samples, all sub-types combined into category totals), which is the primary/canonical sensitivity study covering 459 samples across 6 categories using General protocol, Specific protocol 1 (raw meat/seafood), and Specific protocol 2 (raw dairy) as applicable per category. Sub-type breakdowns (e.g. Composite foods a/b/c) were aggregated into the category "Total" rows as printed in the report; those totals are what is reported here, not further summed. The overall "All categories" row (SEalt 85.5%, SEref 86.9%, RT 86.7%, FP 0.8%) was excluded as a summary/total row per instructions. A separate interlaboratory study (Section 4) also reports sensitivity/accuracy/FP by contamination level (Level 1, Level 2) rather than by food category (single matrix: pasteurized Brie cheese), so it was not used for the per-category table. RLOD acceptability limit for the sensitivity/RLOD study was 2.5 (relevant to level-of-detection, not directly to the sensitivity/trueness table requested).
